svg.title: Decomposing the profit gap: Fashion2 as percentage of Fashion1
svg.desc: Line chart showing Fashion2 customers helped, revenue from employee sales, and total profits as a percentage of Fashion1 across five conditions. Y-axis from 50 to 105 percent.
svg.text: Fashion1 = 100% reference in all conditions. All differences significant at p < 0.001 except TTTT.
